features.title: Walk through the parts, then run the demo
features.intro: Pi Flow runs work as a graph of agents, where each node is a full agent in its own sandbox. An agent designs the graph from a goal, and a background loop writes down what worked so the next run starts ahead.

items.name: Agent cards
items.text: The product section holds still, and each scroll moves exactly one panel: Agents, Workflow, then Memory. Each card names one part of Pi Flow, and its art turns from grey to colour on hover.

items.name: Part pages
items.text: Clicking a card opens a full-screen page on that part, with what it does and a drawing. Arrows in the corners go back to the cards or step to the previous and next part.

items.name: Live demo
items.text: The demo screen runs Pi Flow's real GUI in the page, as a static build with a finished sample run. The TUI tab swaps in the terminal monitor, fed the same sample data.
